using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    long long edges_count = (long long)n * (n - 1) / 2;

    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp_array(n + 1, vector<vector<long long>>(edges_count + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0)));
    dp_array[1][0][1] = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= edges_count; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
                long long val = dp_array[i][j][k];
                if (val == 0) continue;
                if (j + i <= edges_count && k + 1 <= n) {
                    dp_array[i + 1][j + i][k + 1] = (dp_array[i + 1][j + i][k + 1] + val) % mod;
                }
                for (int l = 0; l < i; ++l) {
                    int nj = j + i - 1 - l;
                    if (nj <= edges_count) {
                        dp_array[i + 1][nj][k] = (dp_array[i + 1][nj][k] + val) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> partial_sum_dp(n + 1, vector<vector<long long>>(n + 1, vector<long long>(edges_count + 1, 0)));
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
            long long total = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j <= edges_count; ++j) {
                total = (total + dp_array[i][j][k]) % mod;
                partial_sum_dp[i][k][j] = total;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> cumulative_dp(n + 1, vector<vector<long long>>(edges_count + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0)));
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= edges_count; ++j) {
            long long total = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
                total = (total + partial_sum_dp[i][k][j]) % mod;
                cumulative_dp[i][j][k] = total;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<long long> answers(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        long long answer = (long long)i * answers[i - 1] % mod;
        for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= edges_count; ++j) {
                if (dp_array[i][j][k] == 0) continue;
                long long val = dp_array[i][j][k];
                long long total = cumulative_dp[i][j - 1][n] - (k > 0 ? cumulative_dp[i][j - 1][k] : 0);
                total %= mod;
                answer = (answer + val * total) % mod;
            }
        }
        answers[i] = answer;
    }

    cout << answers[n] % mod << "\n";
    return 0;
}
